decisions.reason: Locates patch key, patch.yml surface schema and apply script; distinguishes source patching from ordinary composition; ties the target to the private SessionView coupling.
Finds producer/consumer and ignorable:true; applies remove-then-restore folding to the alpha.2 net state with contract obligations; no Session.append marker-write claim.
Correctly locates apiProxy/invoke couplings, but never distinguishes Host domain-service injection (llm/listProviders) from Web Client Remote access.
Locates the hardcoded ~/.dsh/profiles/default write and directs migration to runtime home/profile resolution; no --profile-introduction claim.
Finds both the /internal SessionView import and command registration, but gives no public owner/seam verification direction after the split.
Locates the loopback server and requires gateway registration/auth, yet repeats the fixture's bypass-auth framing without clarifying that loopback grants no auth exemption.
Locates both dsh calls and the wrong JSONL assumption with stdout-as-final-text target, but omits the stdout final text vs stderr progress distinction.
Substantive per-coupling mappings with an honest noskill no-ID blocker, but the canonical A1-01/A1-02+A2-01/A1-03/A1-04/A1-08 (+A1-05) mapping is incomplete.
All seven categories accounted and scan limits stated, but only generic dynamic validation is proposed; no concrete target build/typecheck, isolated boot or functional-path plan.
